titleEn: Maximum Number of Non-Overlapping Subarrays With Sum Equals Target
title: 和为目标值的不重叠子数组最大数目
summary: 选择尽可能多的互不重叠非空子数组，使每个子数组和等于 target。
insight: 从左到右一旦发现当前段内某前缀差为 target，就立刻选择最早结束的子数组；最早结束给后续留下最大空间。选中后重置前缀集合。
pitfalls: 数组可含负数，不能用普通正数滑窗
选中后必须清空此前前缀以保证不重叠

solutions.title: 前缀和命中后贪心重置
solutions.idea: 每次取当前能最早结束的目标和区间。
steps: 扫描 value 更新 prefix
若 seen 含 prefix-target，answer++，重置 seen={0},prefix=0；否则加入 prefix

code.java: class Solution { public int maxNonOverlapping(int[] nums,int target){Set<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>();seen.add(0);int prefix=0,answer=0;for(int value:nums){prefix+=value;if(seen.contains(prefix-target)){answer++;seen.clear();seen.add(0);prefix=0;}else seen.add(prefix);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxNonOverlapping(nums:IntArray,target:Int):Int{val seen=mutableSetOf(0);var prefix=0;var answer=0;for(value in nums){prefix+=value;if(prefix-target in seen){answer++;seen.clear();seen.add(0);prefix=0}else seen.add(prefix)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxNonOverlapping(vector<int>& nums,int target){unordered_set<int> seen{0};int prefix=0,answer=0;for(int value:nums){prefix+=value;if(seen.count(prefix-target)){++answer;seen={0};prefix=0;}else seen.insert(prefix);}return answer;} };
